answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 54677 Country: AU Title: Zakat after liabilities Question: I have 70000 cash in bank, but within this month (in 1 week time) I need to pay 50000 to the bank for my liabilities. Do I have to pay zakah on 70000 or (70000-50000 = 20000). Please clarify. Answer ID: 54677 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1320/902/L=10/1435) In the above mentioned case, zakah shall be wajib only on 20000 rupees provided you possess other wealth which makes you sahib nisab and one year has passed over it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
